title: Quran Learning Framework
description: A structured pathway for Quranic learning that takes students from basic Tajweed rules and Surah comprehension through memorization techniques and Arabic language skills, to advanced Tajweed and independent Quranic research.

milestones.title: Beginner Quran Studies
milestones.description: Establish the fundamentals of Quranic recitation, understand the opening chapter, and develop effective study habits for consistent progress.

milestones.title: Intermediate Quran Studies
milestones.description: Advance recitation skills, begin Quran memorization, develop Arabic language proficiency, and learn tafsir methodology for deeper understanding.

milestones.title: Advanced Quran Studies
milestones.description: Master advanced Tajweed rules and develop the research skills needed for independent Quranic scholarship and analysis.
